key_insight: Asynchronous LLM RL needs both policy-side and advantage-side off-policy correction, because stale trajectories create coupled bias and variance that token-level ratio control alone cannot fix.
engineering_relevance: COPC improves training stability and throughput for large-scale LLM post-training, making asynchronous reinforcement learning more practical for tool use and mathematical reasoning.
method: Token-level ratio masking to limit policy mismatch in the actor update.
Two-sided clipped-ratio weighting for TD residuals to correct stale return and advantage estimates.
Couples actor and critic corrections so the two error sources are tuned jointly rather than independently.
evidence_signal: The paper reports broad parameter regions with strong performance, the best reported results on tool-integrated math reasoning and search, stability under 64-step staleness, and a 1.7× step-time speedup over synchronous PPO.
watch_item: Performance depends on coordinated hyperparameters, so poor tuning of the coupled correction terms could negate gains or reduce stability.
paper_title: COPC: Coupled Off-Policy Correction for Asynchronous LLM Reinforcement Learning
